name: Wiktionary MediaWiki API
description: The MediaWiki Action API for Wiktionary, providing access to dictionary content, word definitions, categories, and search functionality. This is the same API engine used by Wikipedia and other Wikimedia projects. All operations use the single /api.php endpoint with different 'action' parameter values.
